domain_patterns.description: Hostname contains an unusually hyphenated label.

urgency.description: Urgent or time-sensitive language was detected.
The message sets a short action deadline.

credential_request.description: The message asks for sensitive account verification or an update.
The message requests credentials or an authentication code.
A sign-in instruction is coupled with account verification language.

account_suspension.description: The message claims that an account may be suspended, restricted, locked, or closed.

financial_bait.description: Payment, banking, or advance-fee language was detected.
A payment is presented as necessary to release or receive funds.

prize_winner.description: Prize, lottery, or winner language was detected.

threat.regex: \b(?:legal action|arrest|prosecution|financial penalty|data will be deleted|permanently disabled)\b
threat.description: The message uses legal, punitive, or data-loss threats.

call_to_action.regex: \b(?:click (?:here|the link)|open the attachment|download the attachment|reply with|sign in now)\b
call_to_action.description: The message contains a direct link, attachment, sign-in, or reply instruction.

commercial_promotion.description: Commercial, promotional, or marketing language was detected.

urgency.regex: (?:khẩn cấp|ngay lập tức|ngay hôm nay|hành động ngay|\bgấp\b)
urgency.description: Vietnamese urgent or time-sensitive language was detected.
The Vietnamese message sets a short action deadline.

credential_request.regex: (?:mật khẩu|thông tin đăng nhập|mã xác thực|mã otp|xác minh danh tính)
credential_request.description: Vietnamese credential or identity-verification language was detected.

credential_request.regex: (?:đăng nhập.{0,60}(?:xác minh|xác nhận|cập nhật)|(?:xác minh|xác nhận).{0,60}đăng nhập)
credential_request.description: A Vietnamese sign-in instruction is coupled with verification language.

account_suspension.regex: (?:tài khoản (?:bị|đã bị)?\s*(?:khóa|tạm khóa)|tạm khóa.{0,30}tài khoản|khóa tài khoản)
account_suspension.description: Vietnamese account-lock or suspension language was detected.

account_suspension.regex: (?:xác minh tài khoản|xác nhận tài khoản|cập nhật tài khoản)

financial_bait.regex: (?:tài khoản ngân hàng|thông tin ngân hàng|chuyển khoản|phí xử lý|thẻ tín dụng)
financial_bait.description: Vietnamese banking, transfer, fee, or credit-card language was detected.
Payment is presented as necessary to receive or unlock funds.

prize_winner.regex: (?:trúng thưởng|nhận thưởng|giải thưởng|nhận quà|người chiến thắng)
prize_winner.description: Vietnamese prize, gift, or winner language was detected.

threat.regex: (?:hành động pháp lý|bị bắt|truy tố|phạt tài chính|dữ liệu sẽ bị xóa|vô hiệu hóa vĩnh viễn)
threat.description: Vietnamese legal, punitive, or data-loss threat language was detected.

call_to_action.regex: (?:nhấp vào (?:đây|liên kết)|bấm vào (?:đây|liên kết)|mở tệp đính kèm|tải tệp đính kèm|trả lời kèm|đăng nhập ngay)
call_to_action.description: The Vietnamese message contains a direct link, attachment, sign-in, or reply instruction.

commercial_promotion.regex: (?:giảm giá|khuyến mãi|ưu đãi|mua ngay|giảm đến|\bsale\b|hủy đăng ký nhận tin)
commercial_promotion.description: Vietnamese commercial, promotional, or marketing language was detected.
